digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow dispatch and runner capacity
propositions: Gerrit Verified workflow dispatches saturate the GitHub Actions runner pool during burst periods, not tickets-branch pushes; measured incident-period peak reached 22 waiting jobs and 14+ minute waits.
Current per-run slot cost ranges from 17 jobs (no mutation shards) to 24 jobs (seven mutation shards), with one macOS job consuming 20-24 minutes of the critical path per full run.
Organization-wide Free plan concurrency limit is 20 total and 5 macOS; repository-local measured queue peaks of 22 waiting jobs indicate organization-level contention beyond this repository.

Independent patchset bursts (three concurrent full routes) require 39 immediate job slots; the observed largest incident burst consumed 379 runner-minutes over seven runs with multiple cancellations, dominated by macOS job serialization.
